# external_llm_dependency_can_fail_or_degrade_compiles

LLM extraction depends on an external provider and a budget; provider unavailability is treated as degrade-with-warning while budget exhaustion raises a CompileError and fails the compile. This external dependency can cause unexpected degraded runs or failed compiles.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._extract_semantic`
- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._llm_enabled`
